notes.title: Yours Truly's Graphical Changes new look!
notes.notes: [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41656015/341125b140955e4fae5a297f9054c7dc648cf0b9.png[/img]Hey everyone! It's been 3 years and some change since I've started developing alone, as fun and challenging as it was it's time to prepare the game for it's release. I wanted to subtly change the look of the game and maximize the aesthetics, so I changed the shading from soft shade to cell shade. I hope you all think it's a good change. Thank you!

notes.title: PlayStation & Switch are controllers currently unsupported
notes.notes:
Hello,

Currently, only Xbox controllers and PC gamepads are supported but don't worry, I will be adding PlayStation controller support sometime in the future. 

always thank you for the support!

notes.title: Climbing Mechanic Input Lag fixed
notes.notes:
A couple of people reported an input lag on the climbing mechanic during the weekend, I've addressed this issue ASAP. The climbing mechanic is now a smoother experience and is responsive to the player's input. Thank you for reporting this issue to me, 

It is essential to me for players to enjoy the Demo, as I am a solo developer, and every impression matters. Please remember to wishlist the game if you enjoyed the demo. 

If you want to accompany me through the development feel free to join the Yours Truly Discord https://discord.gg/tzYqtKAUQN. It is a new Discord Channel and empty, but I am creating a community. Again thank you for the support and love!

notes.title: TRY OUT THE DEMO
notes.notes:
The Demo for Yours Truly is now available for download, I hope you enjoy and relax while playing the game. Remember to Wishlist and thank you! Also if you're interested in accompanying me through the development join the Discord https://discord.gg/tzYqtKAUQN!

Being a solo dev I appreciate all the support and love its what drives me to keep going, Thank you!
